positive.text: Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, Pub. L. No. 111-148, § 1101, 124 Stat. 119, 141-43 (2010).

negative: The public law was signed in 2010 at 124 pages.

note: A public law with its Statutes at Large cite, optional act section and a pincite. A pincite is read only before a year parenthetical (or at the end of the text) so a following `, 42 U.S.C.` is never taken as a page. The key is us.fed.session_law.public_law's (it was us.pl/..., so a govinfo link decoded to a different authority). url_templates: verified by HTTP fetch on 2026-10-23: https://www.govinfo.gov/link/plaw/117/public/58 redirects to PLAW-117publ58.
